## Data Model Signals

### Entities
- **Person / Contact:** Core entity. Fields: First Name, Last Name, Phone, Email, Address, Price, Tags, Stage, Source, Created, Updated, Inactive, Last Visit, Last Communication, Last Text Received
- **Smart List:** id (integer, `3`), name ("All Expireds"), filters (array of filter objects), column configuration (array of visible columns + sort order)
- **Agent / User:** id, name ("Matt Ryan"), assignable to contacts
- **Tag:** String value (e.g., "Expired", "Unsubscribed", "compliance:hard-stop", "Import", "Expired Listing")
- **Stage:** Enum/named stages (e.g., "Active Client" — excluded in filters)
- **Communication Event:** type (email/text/call), timestamp, direction, agent

### Field Types & Enums
- **Tags:** Multi-value string array; filterable with include/exclude operators and any-of/all-of logic
- **Stage:** Single-select enum (stages include at minimum: "Active Client", others implied)
- **Phone:** String with validation status ("is good" boolean flag); supports multiple phone numbers per contact with type designation
- **Last Communication:** Datetime; computed from most recent email/text/call event
- **Last Visit:** Datetime; website visit tracking
- **Last Text Received:** Datetime
- **Created:** Datetime; record creation timestamp; sortable
- **Updated:** Datetime; last record modification
- **Inactive:** Boolean flag
- **Price:** Numeric (real estate context — likely property price or price range of interest)
- **Source:** String/enum (e.g., "Import")
- **Agent / Assigned:** FK to User (e.g., "Matt Ryan")

### Filter Operators (revealed by active filters)
- `Tags exclude any of: [values]` — tag NOT IN array
- `Tags include any of: [values]` — tag IN array
- `Stage excludes any of: [values]` — stage NOT IN array
- `Last Communication more than: [X days/weeks/months]` — datetime relative comparison (older than)
- `Phone is good` — boolean equality (phone has valid/callable number)
- `Agent includes any of: [agents]` — assigned agent IN array

### Smart List Membership Logic
[INFERRED] Smart Lists are dynamic — contacts are automatically added/removed based on real-time filter evaluation. The "34 people" count updates automatically as contact data changes.

### Column Configuration Scope
- Column picker shows "Details (10)" category has 12 options visible (First Name, Last Name, Phone, Email, Address, Price, Tags, Stage, Source, Created, Updated, Inactive) — these are the core "Details" fields
- Additional categories: Assigned (2), Emails (1), Calls, Texts (1), Website activity (5), Deals, Inbox Apps, Custom Fields — these reveal the full data model breadth

```tsx
                <TagPill type="tag">{contact.primaryTag}</TagPill>  {/* "Expired Listing" */}
              </NameCell>
              <DateCell>{contact.created}</DateCell>
              <DateCell>{contact.lastVisit}</DateCell>
              <CommunicationCell>
                <RelativeDate>{contact.lastCommunication}</RelativeDate>
                <AgentAttribution>{contact.lastCommAgent}</AgentAttribution>
              </CommunicationCell>
              <DateCell>{contact.lastTextReceived}</DateCell>
              <PhoneCell>
                <PhoneQualityIcon status={contact.phoneStatus} />  {/* green = good */}
                <PhoneTypeIcon type={contact.phoneType} />  {/* blue circle = mobile/dialer */}
                <PhoneNumber>{contact.phone}</PhoneNumber>
              </PhoneCell>
            </ContactRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </ContactTable>
    </MainContent>

    {/* Columns Picker Popover — renders as floating panel anchored to Columns button */}
    {columnsOpen && (
      <ColumnsPicker>
        <ColumnsPickerLeft>
          <CategoryItem label="Details" count={10} active={true} />
          <CategoryItem label="Assigned" count={2} />
          <CategoryItem label="Emails" count={1} />
          <CategoryItem label="Calls" />
          <CategoryItem label="Texts" count={1} />
          <CategoryItem label="Website activity" count={5} />
          <CategoryItem label="Deals" />
          <CategoryItem label="Inbox Apps" />
          <CategoryItem label="Custom Fields" />
        </ColumnsPickerLeft>
        <ColumnsPickerRight>
          <ColumnToggle field="firstName" label="First Name" checked={false} />
          <ColumnToggle field="lastName" label="Last Name" checked={false} />
          <ColumnToggle field="phone" label="Phone" checked={true} hasFilterIcon />
          <ColumnToggle field="email" label="Email" checked={false} />
          <ColumnToggle field="address" label="Address" checked={false} />
          <ColumnToggle field="price" label="Price" checked={true} />
          <ColumnToggle field="tags" label="Tags" checked={true} hasFilterIcon />
          <ColumnToggle field="stage" label="Stage" checked={true} hasFilterIcon sortIndicator="asc" />
          <ColumnToggle field="source" label="Source" checked={true} />
          <ColumnToggle field="created" label="Created" checked={true} sortIndicator="desc" />
          <ColumnToggle field="updated" label="Updated" checked={true} />
          <ColumnToggle field="inactive" label="Inactive" checked={false} />
        </ColumnsPickerRight>
      </ColumnsPicker>
    )}

    {/* Filters Panel — persistent right sidebar when open */}
    {filtersOpen && (
      <FiltersPanel>
        <AddFilterInput placeholder="Add a filter" />
        <FilterRow
          icon="tag"
          label="Tags exclude any of:"
          value="compliance..."
          expandable
        />
        <FilterRow
          icon="clock"
          label="Last Communication more than..."
          value=""
          expandable
        />
        <FilterRow
          icon="stage"
          label="Stage excludes any of:"
          value="Active C..."
          expandable
        />
        <FilterRow
          icon="phone"
          label="Phone is good"
          value=""
          expandable
        />
        <FilterRow
          icon="tag"
          label="Tags exclude any of:"
          value="Unsubscri..."
          expandable
        />
        <FilterRow
          icon="agent"
          label="Agent includes any of:"
          value="Matt Ryan"
          expandable
        />
        <FilterRow
          icon="tag"
          label="Tags include any of:"
          value="Expired, wi..."
          expandable
        />
        <ClearFiltersLink />
      </FiltersPanel>
    )}
  </AppBody>
</PeoplePage>
```

### Non-Obvious Logic Notes

1. **Smart List ID in URL:** The URL path `/2/people/list/3` uses an integer ID. Smart lists have stable IDs but the ordering in the sidebar may differ from ID order.

2. **"Showing 34 people" vs badge:** The active smart list may not show a count badge in the sidebar (because the count is shown in the main content header instead). Other lists show their counts as badges.

3. **Columns picker — sort indicators in picker:** The column picker shows sort state (↓ on Created, ▲ on Stage) for columns that have sort applied. This is a read indicator inside the picker, not a clickable sort control in this context. The actual sort toggle happens by clicking table column headers.

4. **Tag pill types:** The "Import" source badge and "Expired Listing" tag badge are visually distinct. "Import" is a source/origin label (gray, muted). "Expired Listing" is a user-assigned tag (colored, more prominent). These map to different data fields (contact.source vs contact.tags).

5. **Phone icon combinations:** The green phone icon alone = phone verified as callable. Green phone + blue/purple circle = additional indicator (possibly: FUB dialer-enabled, or mobile confirmed, or text-able). When neither icon is present in a row, the phone column may be empty or unverified.

6. **"Out Of State Home ..." saved view:** This appears to be a named column preset/saved view. FUB likely supports saving a column configuration under a name, then switching between presets via this dropdown. This is separate from the Columns picker (which edits the current view).

7. **Columns picker — filter icons on certain fields:** The ▼ filter icon next to Phone, Tags, and Stage in the columns picker likely indicates these fields also have inline column-level filters available (separate from the global Filters panel).

8. **Last Communication cell sub-text:** Shows both relative time ("7 months ago") AND agent attribution ("1s: Matt Ryan" may mean "last sequence step: Matt Ryan" or "last sender: Matt Ryan"). The "hand: 4me..." may be "handed to me" (assignment note) or "handwritten note." This sub-label is likely from the most recent communication event's metadata.

9. **Filters panel width:** Renders as ~250–280px right panel. The main table compresses to accommodate it when the panel is open. This is NOT a modal — it's a persistent sidebar panel that coexists with the table.

10. **"TC Litigators — Hard Stop"** in sidebar: This smart list name reveals a compliance workflow — contacts flagged as TCPA litigators are isolated in this list and excluded from outreach (the "Hard Stop" implies no communication should be sent).

11. **"Manage" link at bottom of Smart Lists:** Links to `/2/people/smartlists` or similar — the Smart Lists management view (referenced in the second open browser tab "Smart Lists Overview").

12. **Pagination:** With only 34 records, pagination may not be visible (likely shows all 34 on one page). For larger lists, pagination controls would appear at the bottom of the table.

13. **Help bubble:** A `?` circle icon appears in the bottom-right corner of the screen — this is a persistent help widget (likely Intercom or FUB's own help chat launcher).
